adjudication.rationale: In EmbedController#best, when no topic_id is found it enqueues a job: `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` and renders `loading` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). The spec `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb` instead sets expectations that `TopicRetriever.new` is called and that the returned object receives `retrieve`. Since the controller never calls `TopicRetriever` directly in this diff, that mocha expectation will fail (unless the controller behavior is different or jobs are executed inline, neither of which is shown in the diff).
